notes.title: Patch 0.2.78
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283598/5ea5743d5060519b70b45ca9189bab2f48c0c2ee.png

New Features:

 Added a voice chat feature! Now you can communicate with allies directly in the game, using Push-to-Talk or Voice Activation at your discretion!
 Added a cooldown indicator for abilities
 The abilities selection window has been redesigned! Now, choosing new abilities occurs on the right side of the screen and has a more compact look
 Added an option to select abilities using the keys "1/2/3/4"
 Added an option to view all ability combinations, activated using the "ALT" key
 Added an option to display ping in the server list
 Redesigned the "Controls" section in the game settings
 Added a portal icon display on the minimap for the "Accursed Citadel" location

Fixes and Improvements:

 Improved mouse controls
 Fixed the display of statistics at the end of a match
 Fixed the display of the player's progress bar
 Made minor UI fixes
 Made minor fixes to the display of some ability effects
 Made minor fixes to the "Accursed Citadel" scene
 Fixed the subtitles for the cutscene after victory in the "Accursed Citadel" location
 Changed the build compilation method to improve game performance

notes.title: Update 0.2.77.2
notes.content:
New Features:

 Added a shared experience gain mode! This option can be activated in the map selection menu
 Added Steam Cloud synchronization
 Added sound cues for keys in the "Accursed Citadel" location. Now, if you are near a key, you will hear a magical sound indicating that you are on the right path


Additionally, we fixed several bugs:

 Fixed a critical error that caused the game to crash in the "Accursed Citadel" location
 Fixed an issue where two identical weapons could drop
 Fixed an issue with the "Mummy" boss where the boss could disappear
 Now, the "Chest" item you pick up is guaranteed to give you gold
 Slightly improved network connectivity

notes.title: New Update! We heard your Feedback
notes.content:
Dear players, we heard your feedback ! 
We've greatly improved the auto-aim to make the game more fun and rebalanced the gold economy so you can unlock more content faster

We're commited to improving this game update after update during Early Access. Keep giving us feedback!

Here are the more detailed patch notes:

Update 0.2.77.1
New Features:

 The "Herculean Punch" ability now deals damage not only in front of the player but also behind them
 Added mouse cursor control. You can click on the screen to issue movement commands or hold down the right mouse button to continuously move around the location
 Added auto-closing of pop-up windows when opening achievements
 Increased the chance of a chest drop in the "Forgotten Forest" location and in the "Accursed Citadel"
 Increased gold coin income
 Added a coin icon on the minimap
 Now, if the group leader has unlocked a new location and other group members have not, you can still play together in the location that is locked for you
 Increased the size of the tentacles in rage mode for the character "Lyrissa"
 Changed the logic for the weapons "Fireball" and "Rasen Shuriken". Now, these weapons have a 50% chance to attack the first encountered enemy and a 50% chance to attack in a random direction. Previously, these weapons only had random shooting directions


Additionally, we fixed several bugs:

 Fixed an issue where the player or enemies could get stuck in a barrel in the "Accursed Citadel" location
 Fixed the offline mode, now you are guaranteed to be able to play even with the internet disconnected
 Fixed an issue with selecting the character "Ashlyn" in the main menu
 Fixed an issue with obtaining the "Battle Roar" achievement
 Fixed an issue where pressing "Esc" would bring up the exit game window instead of closing the settings window
 Reduced the hitboxes for taking damage for the character
 Made localization fixes

notes.title: DEATHLESS: OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Today's the big day!

DEATHLESS launches now, July 29, at 5:00 PM GMT+2. We are incredibly honored to present this game, which has been our passion project for over two years. We eagerly await your exploration of the game, even if you’ve already checked out the demo during Next Fest and when the new version has been released a few weeks ago.

DEATHLESS is the result of a dedicated team of three full-time members.

Embark on an online co-op Survival Roguelite adventure. Team up with friends, slash through endless waves of foes, conquer formidable bosses, fulfill quests, craft potent weapons, and unlock unique characters!

We are committed to listening to your feedback during the Early Access, continuously optimizing the game, and fixing any bugs that may have slipped through. We have many exciting plans for the game's future and no shortage of ideas!

You are our greatest inspiration on this journey. If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a positive review on Steam—it’s a tremendous support for our studio. Spread the word so others can join the community and share their strategies for conquering the game's challenges.

We wish you a fantastic adventure and look forward to hearing from you soon on Steam, Discord, or social media.

Here's the launch trailer, we hope you'll enjoy it! 
[previewyoutube=Ye5lnc2WeoA;full][/previewyoutube]

If your language is not on the list, please reach out to us! We want to make sure everyone can enjoy the game in the language they prefer. Please reach out to contact@bark.games or on our Discord

notes.title: Coming in the New Year.
notes.content:
Dear Deathless Community,

Your feedback from the October demo day has been invaluable, prompting us to enhance the game experience and redefine level objectives. As a result, we've decided to adjust our release date to Feb-March 2024.

Recent updates include:

* Expanded Level Objectives: In addition to survival and boss battles, new tasks have been introduced. Now, you must strategically decide whether to collect and upgrade abilities or use them to restore portals.

[previewyoutube=dk0q1P32qDA;full][/previewyoutube]

* New Location and enemy characters - Forgotten Crypts: Explore ancient catacombs to uncover clues about Deathless's vulnerabilities and the location of the Key of Worlds, joining Forgotten Forest and Wastelands.

[previewyoutube=T0vSIg87ki8;full][/previewyoutube]

* Narrative Prologue Completion: The prologue, enriched with visuals, sets the stage for the gripping Deathless narrative.

[previewyoutube=c683ngZancs;full][/previewyoutube]

* Original Soundtracks: Delve into the atmospheric world of Deathless with two original soundtracks that enhance the immersive experience.

* Replaced Online P2P Multiplayer with an Online Client-Server system with a much more stable connection.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to refine and elevate your Deathless experience.

notes.title: Technical demo v0.2.0
notes.content:
One of the most significant aspects of this update is the new enemy synchronization system, which greatly surpasses the previous one!


Now, basic character abilities are displayed.
New sound settings sliders have been added.
A pause in single-player mode now smoothly appears.
Gameplay balance adjustments have been made.
Issues with the Atar character have been resolved.
The problem of Dash through fog during boss battles has been fixed.
The spawning of "Chaos Meteor" weapons has been corrected.
An error causing disconnection when the Enter key was pressed multiple times during level loading has been addressed.

notes.title: Technical demo v0.1.27
notes.content:
We closely monitored all of your messages regarding the demo version of Deathless. Our team expresses gratitude to every player who shared their feedback with us! We made an effort to take into account all the key aspects you mentioned in your messages and incorporated them into the new update v0.1.27.


We've introduced a new feature that allows trees to become transparent when they obstruct a character.
Now you can adjust the volume of the sound (other settings will be available in future updates).
Game balance changes have been implemented.
An issue related to armor has been fixed; previously, the maximum armor level blocked 100% of damage.
Character attributes have been slightly modified (please note that this is not the final version).
The display of the number of collected coins on the statistics screen has been fixed. You will now see the total value of the collected coins, not just the quantity.
An issue with the display of allies on the mini-map has been resolved.
An error associated with fog has been fixed. Now, when a boss appears, players cannot leave the fog.
An error causing health regeneration after a player's death has been corrected.
A network game error related to players having identical nicknames has been fixed.
An error allowing the exceeding of the maximum player count in a single lobby has been resolved.
An issue related to the "Bug Report" window in the game menu has been fixed.
An error causing double weapon accrual has been addressed.
A pause option has been added when playing in solo mode.
Vsync support has been added.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest development update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thank you for your valuable feedback and bug reports. We greatly appreciate your input as we actively develop our demo. Your recommendations are invaluable, and we are committed to enhancing the game's balance, stability, and overall enjoyment.

In our upcoming early access version in November, expect numerous fixes and exciting additions. This includes the ability to modify weapons by combining passive and active items, unique stats for each hero, and the exciting concept of hero soul modification - all of which will be part of the final release version.

Moreover, you can look forward to diverse map types, including dungeons, team tasks, and exploration missions. Our sound design will receive further refinement, and we're dedicated to fine-tuning the game's balance to achieve the optimal difficulty ratio. Your support is crucial to our development journey, and we can't wait to provide you with an even better gaming experience.

Tune in to our livestream currently too and feel free to ask us any questions in the community group. We have several videos going live from influencers including reviews, let's plays and a special featuring on Friday so stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283598/832d9f8f2ee5bb825983873f4e3710a0f0071905.png

Make sure to wishlist the game as we drop new regular updates on the road to launch too!

notes.title: Play Deathless for the first time at Steam Next Fest on October 9th!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We're really pleased to announce that we'll be giving players their first chance to get hands on with our upcoming online roguelike Deathless at Steam Next Fest on October 9th! Everyone will be able to jump online and experience the world of Deathless for a full week, where we'll be giving the first taste of what our intense multiplayer roguelike has in store. 

We've also just dropped a brand new gameplay trailer to celebrate the announcement which you can check out below! 

[previewyoutube=_Vl3e19xJ-U;full][/previewyoutube]

As well as getting hands on with the game, we'll also be doing a livestream during the week, including questions to one of the lead developers at OneTwoPlay surrounding things Deathless, so keep an eye out for that on our main store page.

Make sure to wishlist the game below too, as we have lots in store for this page going forward, including insights into games development, details on new features, updates and more!
